scope: ACT3_B005 production motion and review policy only
productionMotionRequirement: The customer slides the card horizontally across the desk. The card remains flat, face-up and in continuous contact with the wood surface throughout the movement. It must not be lifted, carried, tilted, flipped or allowed to hover. The customer’s fingertips guide the card along the desk while the banker begins typing. Camera position and framing remain locked.
rejectionConditions: The card visibly separates from the desk.
The customer carries rather than slides the card.
The card design changes during the shot.
Text, numbers, logos or personal information appear.
Hands deform or lose plausible contact.
fallbackPolicy: If a generative animation cannot satisfy the surface-contact requirement, route ACT3_B005 to deterministic/keyframed animation. Do not repeatedly regenerate it in an attempt to force compliance.
signatureNote: Human decision supplied directly by Yakubu Moshood; no cryptographic signature claimed.
